parakeet: The other nine apostles? Here's where the entire narrative unravels. Their names appear only in gospel lists, and those lists don't even match across Matthew, Mark, Luke, and Acts. Most of them never speak, don't act, and disappear after a single mention, have no writings, and are never independently confirmed in any first-century Jewish or Roman document. Some don't even show up in Paul's letters, which predate the Gospels. These are not historical figures, they're characters in a theological drama.
